paragraphs: Menaḥem ben Sagnai, Eduyot 7:8, in Rabban Gamliel and R. Yoḥanan ben Gudgada's time. Tosefta, end of Eduyot: they seated him at the academy's head because he testified to the laws, and they marveled at him.
